ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Edputil.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "edputil.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\edputil\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")))
